model_annotation: Figure 3, titled "模型推理速度对照结果图" (Model Inference Speed Comparison Results), presents a line graph comparing the F1 scores of three different models—lattice, FLAT, and OURS—over a range of epochs. The x-axis, labeled "epoch(次)" (epoch), is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 18, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "F1分数" (F1 Score), is a linear scale ranging from 0.55 to 0.90, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The graph displays three distinct lines: the red line with square markers, representing the "lattice" model, starts at an F1 score of approximately 0.60 at epoch 0 and increases sharply to a value of approximately 0.77 at epoch 4, after which it continues to rise more gradually, reaching a value of approximately 0.87 at epoch 16. The blue line with circular markers, representing the "FLAT" model, begins at an F1 score of approximately 0.80 at epoch 0, rises to a peak of approximately 0.87 at epoch 4, and then remains relatively stable, showing a slight increase to a value of approximately 0.89 at epoch 16. The yellow line with triangular markers, representing the "OURS" model, starts at an F1 score of approximately 0.82 at epoch 0, increases steadily throughout the epochs, and reaches a value of approximately 0.90 at epoch 16.
